flow_summary: The interviewer mostly asks one question at a time and eventually obtains answers, but for this confused/disorganised patient it relies on mechanical repetition (“Please repeat your date of birth…”, “Please repeat the postal code…”, “Please repeat your 10-digit phone number”) instead of breaking questions down or guiding the patient. Vague or uncertain replies are rarely clarified beyond re-asking the identical item; safety disclosure receives an appropriate follow-up question.
